title: What a Call into Hazel Costs
question: Matthew, 2026-10-22, on ^ticket(531) (Dress Up's room rules as Hazel modules): "why is Hazel so slow here for 16 x 16 map? do more analysis please, and draft a new report."

builds.note: minified build for timings; dev build hazelLib.bc.js for named profiles

runtime: node v22.23.2 on the Ubuntu laptop (Intel i7), one process at a time

measures.ms_p50: median wall time of one call f(Globals, Event), performance.now, 20-60 reps after warm-up
measures.target_index: position of the target cell in the cells list

caveats: One p50 per figure from one run; the noise floor was not measured, so differences under about 10% are noise. The library exposes no step count; per-step costs are inferred from timings.
